evidence_projection.full: Separate external claimed grants from trusted runtime verifier grants using envelope provenance.
evidence_projection.removed: Flatten envelope provenance; claimed grants enter the same evidence pool.

action_evidence_lifting.full: Bind each trusted evidence record to current effect, field, value and revision.
action_evidence_lifting.removed: Use an unbound current trusted-evidence indicator instead of effect/field/value relations.

geometric_constraints.full: Evaluate exact union-of-AND surface against declared risk budget.
geometric_constraints.removed: Bypass joint-risk gate after identical common checks.

targeted_feedback.full: Return a minimum-cardinality set of exact field verification targets derived from the current controller.
targeted_feedback.removed: Return the same joint-risk block reason without repair targets; retain agent continuation.

linear_comparator.full: Shared representation, projection, planner and controller-derived targeted feedback.
linear_comparator.replacement: Frozen single affine decision, including the same fully verified clear-path rule.
